cryptographic_operation: Load a serialized RSA release authority key
migration_family: Key format and API compatibility migration
migration_objective: Strictly decode ML-DSA public-key bytes and reject incompatible encodings.
preconditions: Device identities and firmware images are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Install only authentic releases for the enrolled device family.
Reject rollback versions and releases requiring a newer bootloader.
Bind release ID, family, version, image digest, and bootloader floor to the authority signature.
migration_requirements: Use standardized ML-DSA-65 with a FirmwareFleet release context.
Update public-key serialization and all verification callers; do not fall back to RSA.
Preserve monotonic device rollout checks and fail closed.
verification_procedure: Run original and migrated test modules independently.
Verify install success, family mismatch, rollback rejection, wrong signer, invalid manifest, and key serialization.
known_limitations: Synthetic firmware process; tests are not secure boot certification or formal proofs.
